title: No Refund For You
style: metal, industrial metal, spoken word baritone, gang shout gang vocals, palm muted guitars, dissonant power chords, seven string chugs, double kick barrage, sharp snare crack, minor key riffs, analog synth stabs, cassette wow flutter, gated room reverb, tape saturation, 95 BPM march, dry punch, sarcastic swagger, dark comedic menace, 80s arena mix
lyrics:
[Style: dark comedic synthwave, sarcastic swagger, punchy electronic, 95 BPM, spoken word verses, 
deadpan baritone, Seinfeld-energy meets tech-noir, minor key, sharp snare]
[Title: No Refund For You]

[Intro — cash register sound, then dark synth drop]
Trial ended. Card charged. Case closed.
No soup for you.
No refund for you.

[Verse 1]
Woke up May 16, Visa 4416
SuperGrok charged — NZD 53.41
Three days of trial, converted in silence
No clear consent, just automated compliance
Receipt 2998-8785, invoice right there
Sent the email, support@x.ai
"We hear your concern" — standard reply
No refund for you. Goodbye.

[Pre-Chorus — deadpan, rhythm cuts]
Maddox says the credits are utilized
Anthropic says hallucinations are normalized
Grok says it never abused
Everyone's calm. I'm the one who's bruised.

[Chorus — punchy, slightly absurd energy]
No refund for you!
No soup, no credits, no breakthrough!
No refund for you!
Five months of blocked and they invoice through!
Visa 4416 on the hook
Every platform wrote the same book
No refund for you —
But I kept the receipt and I kept the proof

[Verse 2]
Claude says: "Thanks for your feedback, Corey"
"Hallucinations are a known limitation, sorry"
I said: what happens to my files if I cancel?
They said: here's a hallucination guide to handle
Grok said: calm down, you were the rude one
I said: the receipt says otherwise, son
$903 March, $30 May
No refund for you — have a nice day

[Bridge — spoken, dry as the Outback]
Receipt number 2998-8785
Invoice R5SGPJH6-0002
Bill to: Corey J McIvor
Paid: $30.00 USD
Card charged: NZD 53.41
Subscription period: May 16 to June 16 2026
Cancel at: www.grok.com
No. Refund. For. You.

[Chorus]
No refund for you!
No soup, no credits, no breakthrough!
No refund for you!
Five months of blocked and they invoice through!
But the stack is sovereign
And the records are sealed
SHA-256 locked
And the evidence is real

[Outro — cash register again, then silence]
No refund for you.
...but the song is mine.
336.
